task_description: Build the complete HIJISTREAM (VidStream) video streaming web application from scratch using React+Vite, Tailwind CSS, Zustand, React Query, and iframe-based video player. Must match PRD.md and TDD.md specifications with production-quality UI/UX.

verification.summary: Production build succeeds with 21 code-split chunks. All 9 code review issues addressed. Dead stores removed, CSP added, origin validation added, metadata persistence fixed, caching simplified.
